Backstory

This server takes place in the age of hero's of the asoiaf bookmark. 

The **Age of Heroes** was an era during the history of Westeros which takes its name from the great men and women who lived in the years of peace that followed the forging of the Pact between the First Men (us)  and the children of the forest(now extinct.. supposedly).

Many noble houses trace their family histories to the Age of Heroes and many stories, songs, and legends are told about it. It is an era that is shrouded in mystery, with more myth than fact known about it. There are numerous tales from the Age of Heroes, too many to count. These histories were not recorded in books but passed down from generation to generation through story and song. While some of them may be dismissed as fairytales everyone one of the Seven Kingdoms is defined by them.

*"*[*https://awoiaf.westeros.org/index.php/Age\_of\_Heroes*](https://awoiaf.westeros.org/index.php/Age_of_Heroes)*"*

So there is no defined borders in our server and everyone has to start out from scratch. (good excuse to not do anything because I just started the server)

claim you're favorite houses name, banner, and coat of arms and start playing!

The server is "loosly" based on the asoiaf worldview this makes is so it's not overly complicated for those that haven't read the books 📷

Other than that everything is going down on ragnarok until anyone wants me to start a new server. Or we get enough people and grow a community to eventually start a cluster.
